name: hr
description: HR staff (directory, leave, training for their department) and HR managers (plus pay for their team).

hr_staff.description: HR staff: the people directory, leave and training records of their own department.

row_scopes.explain: rows of the user's own department (attribute dept)

hr_manager.description: HR managers: everything HR staff see, plus pay for themselves and their team.

row_scopes.explain: pay rows of the user and their team (attribute self_and_subordinate_ids: a comma-separated list of employee ids)
